title: The Cellar of Marrow Creek
author: Sable Fairweather
blurb: Isandro Ravensworth, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
